title: DAPermission - Permission Mod
description: 🛡️ A permission-based system to control block usage on Fabric servers
body:
🔐 DAPermission
🛡️ A permission-based system to control block usage on Fabric servers
⚙️ What is it?

Hi! 👋
I made DAPermission to solve a simple problem on modded and roleplay servers:

    How can we prevent players from using powerful or special blocks unless they’re allowed to?

This mod lets you restrict the use (right-click) of specific blocks and items using permissions.
If a player doesn’t have the correct node, they won’t be able to use the block — and they’ll see a red warning.
🧩 What it supports

I included a wide range of blocks from popular mods, like:

    ⚙️ Create

    🍲 Farmer’s Delight

    🍇 Vinery

    🔥 Candlelight

    ✨ Myth & Magic

    🛠️ Chipped

    ...and vanilla of course!

🎯 Why I made it

This mod is great for:

    👑 RP servers (like jobs and professions)

    🔐 Protected areas (labs, factories, etc.)

    🎮 Giving admins full control over who can use what

And don’t worry — it’s server-side only.
Players don’t need to install anything to join!
✅ Requirements

You’ll need:

    fabric-permissions-api

     LuckPerms for managing permission nodes easily

📦 Example permission

To use an anvil:
permissionmod.use.minecraft:anvil

To use a Create water wheel:
permissionmod.use.create:water_wheel

format: 
permissionmod.use.<namespace>:<block_id>
